blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former Surigao del Norte Rep. Robert Ace Barbers has accused Vice President Sara Duterte’s lawyers of issuing veiled threats about possible criminal liability for disclosing Anti-Money Laundering Council (AMLC) reports. This alleged action happens even when the impeachment court had already ruled on the matter. Barbers, the spokesperson for the prosecution panel, made his sentiment known in a press briefing on Monday night, after the 33rd day of Duterte’s impeachment trial. He said that it seems the defense panel did not do its homework as it refused to stop its threats, despite the fact that Presiding Officer and Senator-judge Francis […]...
